failure_mechanisms.description: Saab/GM documents ignition discharge module failure from electrical overload; original report describes heat-related IGBT damage. This is ONE engineering failure mechanism with distinct 4-cylinder and B308 cohort cases.
failure_mechanisms.factory_failure_mechanism: IDM electrical overload / heat-sensitive IGBT failure
failure_mechanisms.scope_note: Do not pool or equate original module hardware, actual application, case consequences, recall populations, part replacements, incidence or severity between four-cylinder and B308 cases.

failure_mechanisms.description: Insufficient sealing at 9-3 (9440) FA57 oil cooler pipe nipples permits coolant contamination of automatic transmission fluid in bulletin-scoped vehicles.
failure_mechanisms.factory_failure_mechanism: FA57 oil cooler line nipple sealing inadequacy
failure_mechanisms.scope_note: Technical advice applies to separate SS, SS TiD and CV VIN cutoff lines; no engine code inferred; not the scope of a separate campaign and not proof any given gearbox is contaminated.
